name: Israel, Gaza & region
value: Houthi drones over Saudi 16 Nov; Gaza strikes
summary: Saudi Arabia intercepted Houthi drones over the Mecca and Riyadh regions on 16 Nov; Israeli fire killed 3 in Gaza
state: A Saudi-led coalition spokesperson said two Houthi drones were intercepted over the Mecca and Riyadh regions on 16 Nov (ABC News). In Gaza, three Palestinians were killed by Israeli fire in Rafah and Gaza City on 16 Nov, according to medical sources; Gaza's health ministry says 1,643 people have been killed by Israeli fire since the ceasefire took effect (Anadolu via A News). Cross-border attacks on the Yemen–Saudi front, alongside Iranian strikes on Bahrain on 13 and 15 Nov (Euronews), keep the Alert.
for_you: Travellers to Israel, the Palestinian territories, Lebanon, Yemen and Saudi Arabia should check FCDO travel advice, which can change at short notice. Regional flights may be diverted or cancelled.
rubric_hit: Multi-front escalation: Houthi drones at Saudi Arabia (16 Nov), Iranian strikes on Bahrain, continued Gaza strikes
